# Forge DevKit

> Forge DevKit is a commercial plugin ecosystem for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) by Reumbra. One command runs a 7-gate architecture audit of your repository and generates AI guardrails your agent follows in every session.

Forge DevKit ships 15 modules and is sold as a one-time purchase, not a subscription: Starter EUR 29, Pro EUR 79, Complete EUR 149. Each purchase includes 1 year of updates; renewal after that is optional, at a reduced price (Starter EUR 19/yr, Pro EUR 49/yr, Complete EUR 89/yr), and generated artifacts keep working with or without renewal. Device activations per license: Starter 2, Pro 3, Complete 5. There is a 14-day money-back guarantee.

Tiers are cumulative by module set:
- Starter (EUR 29): forge-core, forge-worktree.
- Pro (EUR 79): everything in Starter, plus forge-product, forge-qa, forge-tracker, forge-prompts (6 modules total).
- Complete (EUR 149): everything in Pro, plus forge-autopilot and 8 product-advisory modules - forge-discovery, forge-marketing, forge-analytics, forge-onboarding, forge-copy, forge-seo, forge-growth, forge-ab (all 15 modules, plus every future module).

forge-core's audit covers 50+ quality patterns and includes 15 rationalization detectors that catch common AI shortcuts. Artifacts are generated into `.claude/` (or equivalent) and keep working even if a plugin is later removed.

## Modules

- [forge-core](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/core/): Architecture audit and AI guardrails, quality patterns, dev-skills generation. Starter tier and above.
- [forge-worktree](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/worktree/): Parallel git worktree branches with zero port conflicts. Starter tier and above.
- [forge-product](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/product/): Feature design in business language, user stories with acceptance criteria. Pro tier and above.
- [forge-qa](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/qa/): Test generation traced to requirements, across 8+ test frameworks. Pro tier and above.
- [forge-tracker](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/tracker/): Syncs your task tracker (GitHub, ClickUp, Linear, Notion, Jira) with your AI agent. Pro tier and above.
- [forge-prompts](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/prompts/): Manages prompts like code, with prompt inventory, audit, and regression tests. Pro tier and above.
- [forge-autopilot](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/autopilot/): Agent Teams batch orchestration across a backlog, with conflict-free wave execution. Complete tier only.
- [forge-discovery](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/discovery/): Product discovery and problem validation before you build. Complete tier only.
- [forge-marketing](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/marketing/): Positioning, pricing, and go-to-market strategy. Complete tier only.
- [forge-analytics](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/analytics/): Measurement planning - tracking plans, event schemas, dashboard specs. Complete tier only.
- [forge-onboarding](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/onboarding/): Activation flow design from signup to first value. Complete tier only.
- [forge-copy](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/copy/): Consistent product copy and brand voice across every surface. Complete tier only.
- [forge-seo](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/seo/): SEO strategy and technical audit grounded in the product, not generic tactics. Complete tier only.
- [forge-growth](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/growth/): Retention loops and referral mechanics before acquisition tactics. Complete tier only.
- [forge-ab](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/ab/): Structured A/B test design, sample-size pre-commitment, and analysis. Complete tier only.

## Pricing and Docs

- [Pricing](https://forge.reumbra.com/pricing/): Full tier comparison table, feature matrix, and pricing FAQ.
- [Getting Started](https://forge.reumbra.com/docs/getting-started/): Install Forge DevKit and run the first architecture audit.
- [Usage Guide](https://forge.reumbra.com/docs/usage-guide/): Command reference and workflow for every module.
- [Concepts](https://forge.reumbra.com/docs/concepts/): Meta-tool architecture, disposable artifacts, detection over configuration.
- [Interactive Guide](https://forge.reumbra.com/docs/interactive-guide/): Walkthrough of setup, hub routing, the dev pipeline, quality guardrails, test generation, task sync, and Agent Teams.
- [Modules Directory](https://forge.reumbra.com/modules/): Index of all 15 modules.
